function.name: list_directory
function.description:
List all filenames (files and subdirectories) in a given directory path. Returns a JSON array of filename strings.

PATH RULES:
- Use absolute Windows paths like C:\Users\f\Desktop or relative paths like ./src
- Forward slashes (/) are accepted and will be normalized (e.g. C:/Users/f/Desktop works)
- ~/ at the start of a path will be expanded to the current user home directory
- Do NOT use shell-specific patterns like ~username/other — only ~/ at the beginning is supported
- Relative paths are resolved against the server's current working directory

EXAMPLES of valid paths:
- "." — current working directory
- "./src" — src subdirectory relative to CWD
- "C:/Users/f/Desktop" — absolute Windows path to Desktop
- "~/Desktop" — user home directory + Desktop
- "~/Documents" — user home directory + Documents

BEHAVIOR:
- On success: returns JSON array like ["file1.txt","subdir","file2.js"]
- On error (directory not found, permission denied, etc.): returns {"error":"..."} with the error message
- Empty directories return []

path.description: Directory path to list. Supports: absolute Windows paths (C:\Users\...), relative paths (./src, ..), and ~/ for home directory. For the user's Desktop try "~/Desktop". For the current directory try ".".
